title: video.participant.left
description: A connection's stay in a call ended: the closing half of a presence span, carrying the finished interval and how we learned of it. close_reason is the provenance of left_at — "webhook" (the media server observed the departure, the only witness that survives a client crash), "explicit" (a leave button or a kick), "sweeper" (nobody reported it; the reconciler found the connection gone and closed the span at the last moment it was confirmed present, so the value is an estimate bounded by the sweep interval). duration_seconds is raw: no threshold, no rounding, no plan. Emitted once per span — a closed span is never reopened or restated, so a redelivered departure emits nothing.
